title: Set the introduction style for the first paragraph after the title
goal: Use adjacent sibling selectors to distinguish introductions from subsequent paragraphs.
summary: The paragraph immediately following the title of each column is a short introduction, and the other paragraphs thereafter are displayed as ordinary text.
tasks: Use a selector to set the p immediately following h2 to a thickness of 700.
retains the original styles of subsequent paragraphs and column titles.

example.note: The plus sign matches the second item immediately following the previous element that shares the same parent element. The wavy line can select multiple brothers behind it.

hint: The target is to the right of the plus sign. Write h2 first, and then write the p you want to match.
